name: codex-token-cost
description: Show per-turn and session model request counts and token costs from Codex rollout usage data.

interface.shortDescription: Show model request counts and configured costs after each turn.
interface.longDescription: Reads the usage already recorded by Codex, counts model responses, calculates exact configured model costs, and displays turn and session totals without additional API requests.
defaultPrompt: Show the token cost from my latest Codex turn.
